### ✨ 本次更新
🚀 功能与体验增强
- **灵活的历史记录管理**：新增历史记录保留时长选项，让你更自由地掌控数据与存储空间。 - **菜单栏图标隐身**：现在支持隐藏顶部系统菜单栏图标了，为你提供更纯净的桌面环境。 - **通用设置界面焕新**：全面优化了「通用」设置模块的布局与 UI 设计，视觉更清晰，操作更直观。 - **界面视觉减负**：精简并移除了部分冗余的提示语，进一步提升了应用界面的清爽度与美观度。
⚙️ 性能与稳定性
- **CPU 性能调优**：优化了底层逻辑，修复了特定场景下 CPU 占用率短暂异常飙高的问题，应用运行更加平稳省电。
---
### ✨ What's New
🚀 Features & Enhancements
- **Custom History Retention**: Added a new setting to choose how long your clipboard history is saved, giving you better control over your data storage. - **Hideable Menu Bar Icon**: You can now choose to hide the app icon from the macOS menu bar for a completely clutter-free status bar. - **General Settings Redesign**: Adjusted the layout and UI of the General settings module, making it more intuitive and organized. - **Cleaner Interface**: Removed unnecessary prompts and tooltips to keep the visual experience sleek and distraction-free.
⚙️ Performance & Stability
- **CPU Usage Optimization**: Fixed an issue that caused sudden CPU usage spikes in certain scenarios, ensuring smoother and more energy-efficient performance in the background.

### ✨ 本次更新
🎨 视觉与体验优化
- **焕新应用图标**：换上全新设计的 App Icon，视觉表达更契合应用的高效剪贴板定位。 - **界面细节打磨**：对部分界面的 UI 进行了微调，视觉呈现更加自然协调。
🚀 功能与交互增强
- **新增专属交流群**：新增了 Telegram 用户交流群组入口，欢迎随时加入，与我们聊聊你的想法和建议。 - **优化安装页视觉体验**: 新增安装页背景和拖拽提醒 ---
### ✨ What's New
🎨 Visual & UX Improvements
- **Brand New App Icon**: Upgraded to a newly designed icon that better reflects our core product philosophy and positioning. - **UI Refinements**: Made several minor visual adjustments across the app for a more polished and cohesive look.
🚀 Features & Enhancements
- **Join Our Community**: Added a link to our official Telegram group. Come hang out, share your feedback, and chat with us! - **Optimize the installation page visual experience**: Added installation page background and drag reminder

### ✨ 本次更新
🎨 视觉与体验优化
- **焕新应用图标**：换上全新设计的 App Icon，视觉表达更契合应用的高效剪贴板定位。 - **界面细节打磨**：对部分界面的 UI 进行了微调，视觉呈现更加自然协调。
🚀 功能与交互增强
- **权限授权无缝衔接**：大幅优化辅助功能授权体验，现在点击“去系统设置授权”后，Clipaste 会自动出现在系统的辅助功能列表中，免去手动寻找的烦恼。 - **新增专属交流群**：新增了 Telegram 用户交流群组入口，欢迎随时加入，与我们聊聊你的想法和建议。

### ✨ What's New
🎨 Visual & UX Improvements
- **Brand New App Icon**: Upgraded to a newly designed icon that better reflects our core product philosophy and positioning. - **UI Refinements**: Made several minor visual adjustments across the app for a more polished and cohesive look.
🚀 Features & Enhancements
- **Seamless Authorization**: Optimized the Accessibility permission flow. Clicking "Open System Settings" will now automatically reveal Clipaste in the macOS settings list, saving you time. - **Join Our Community**: Added a link to our official Telegram group. Come hang out, share your feedback, and chat with us!
